alt.en: A row of gray switchgear cabinets stands in an electrical room, with metal conduits rising to the ceiling. One cabinet carries a round, glass-covered electricity meter with a digital display and a blue tag, below a second round fitting.
alt.zh: 电气室里立着一排灰色开关柜，金属导管向上通到天花板。其中一个柜体上装着一块罩着玻璃的圆形电表，带数字显示屏和一个蓝色标签，上方还有另一个圆形装置。

caption.en: Main service switchgear fitted with an electricity meter in a data center power room, photographed in 2012. The photo does not show a verifier's meter or the equipment the researchers used.
caption.zh: 数据中心配电室里的主进线开关柜，柜上装有电表，摄于 2012 年。照片中并非验证方的电表，也没有研究人员所用的设备。
